note: benchmark suite 6: the wait spike and one small-town turn run

tests.name: waitpoll
tests.what: Sleeping wait against woken wait, 6 shapes
tests.read: photo every page, the graphs especially
tests.title: Sleeping vs woken wait
tests.shows: Times the PVR wait two ways: sleeping, woken

card.what: Times the PVR wait two ways, sleeping and woken, in six shapes, and draws the results as graphs.
card.controls: Automatic run, about one minute. A and B turn the pages, Start on the last page runs it again. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Not measured yet: this disc is the first console run of the woken wait in this program.

tests.name: turn-gv
tests.read: photo every page; compare with the other turn runs
tests.title: Small town turn cost
tests.shows: Closed walled square, fog, all speed steps

card.what: The 36-stage camera turn test on the small closed walled square, with every speed step on: bound world, still-camera visibility, ground culled, sun tables kept.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 8 to 10 minutes; a stage counter shows how far. Start stops it early. A and B turn the result pages, A held 2 s on the last page or A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Not measured yet: this disc is the first console run of this test.

not_in_menu.subtitle: Not a demo: nothing to run.
not_in_menu.intro: These effects are in the library, but this menu has no demo for them. Each line says where else the effect is shown.
